Name: Pockets Auto Tool Patches
Author: ThaleTheGreat
Description:
A patch to allow [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15216]Tool Smart Switch[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21050]Automate Tool Swap I Switch I Select[/url] to use tools from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46564]Pockets[/url].

[b]All of my mods and their source code are on [url=https://github.com/ThaleTheGreat/ThalesStardewValleyMods]GitHub[/url][/b]

Manifest.Name: Pockets Auto Tool Patches
Manifest.Description: Lets supported auto-tool mods use tools stored in Pockets.
